Facts: SPY is above its 50- and 200-session averages but slightly below its 20-session average; financial-condition and stress proxies are benign, while CPI is 3.35% year over year, VIX is at the 66.7th percentile of its supplied history, and an FOMC meeting is scheduled for September 16. Inference: long-trend and non-stress evidence is constructive, but near-term momentum, inflation-policy risk, volatility, and concentration prevent a bullish conclusion. The technical signals are correlated transformations of the same price series, and the risk-appetite proxy also reuses VIX, RSI, and watchlist moving-average breadth, so these must not be counted as independent confirmation.
